offering_description.value: Installs and operates electronic gaming machines in bars, restaurants, truck stops and other licensed venues. It supplies and maintains the equipment and shares gaming proceeds with host businesses. It also makes gaming machines and operates an Illinois casino and horse racetrack for consumers.

primary_services.value: distributed gaming operations; amusement machine operations; casino gaming; horse racing and wagering; ATM services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Bars, restaurants, truck stops, convenience stores, fraternal clubs and gaming operators; B2C: Adult gaming patrons, casino visitors and horse racing bettors
